name: Trend Intelligence API (Cross-Platform Research)
description: Real-time trending topics across Reddit, web, YouTube, and Twitter/X. Cross-platform research with sentiment analysis and pattern detection.
longDescription: Aggregates trending content across 4 platforms via mobile proxies. Returns engagement-ranked topics with source URLs, sentiment analysis, and cross-platform correlation. Identify emerging trends before they peak.

endpoints.description: Trending topics across Reddit, web, YouTube, Twitter/X
Cross-platform research synthesis (price scales with platforms)

whyMobileProxy: Reddit killed free API access in 2023. Twitter/X API starts at $100/mo. YouTube trends are geo-fenced. Mobile carrier IPs bypass all these restrictions — Reddit sees you as a real phone user, Twitter as a mobile app, YouTube serves country-specific content by carrier geo.
